data.scope: First page of the official national advisory index; not a complete historical or district-filtered warning feed.
data.note: Publication dates have no supplied time of day. Open the official PDF to verify affected areas, instructions and validity. Older documents may have expired. Index availability and an absent district name never establish safety.

source.name: Open-Meteo Weather
source.methodology: Numerical weather forecast. UTC windows are anchored to request time, not array index. Forecast valid time is not model issuance time.

source.name: Open-Meteo · Detailed Forecast
source.methodology: Seven-day point model outlook with hourly humidity, apparent temperature, precipitation probability and 10 m wind/gusts. Same upstream family as the core weather snapshot.
source.license: CC BY 4.0; free API subject to non-commercial limits

source.name: GloFAS · Open-Meteo Flood
source.methodology: Daily modelled discharge, seven-day hindcast and seven-day forecast for the largest river in a 5 km area. Trends describe model output, not a flood warning or gauge reading.
source.license: CC BY 4.0; free API subject to non-commercial limits

source.name: CAMS · Open-Meteo Air
source.methodology: Modelled surface air quality; not a physical ground monitor.
source.license: CC BY 4.0; free API subject to non-commercial limits

source.name: Copernicus DEM · Open-Meteo
source.methodology: Single-point terrain elevation; slope cannot be derived from a single sample.

source.name: USGS Earthquake Hazards
source.methodology: Instrument-derived events within a rectangular monitoring area; includes cross-border events. No geographic district attribution.

source.name: RainViewer Radar
source.methodology: Past radar tile metadata only. Local coverage is not guaranteed. Public nowcast discontinued January 2026.

source.name: NOAA Space Weather
source.methodology: Estimated planetary Kp index. Global geomagnetic context; not a local climate hazard.

source.name: UN OCHA ReliefWeb
source.methodology: Human-curated Pakistan reports. Report time and retrieval time remain separate.

source.methodology: Public NASA South Asia VIIRS SNPP file, filtered to the monitoring rectangle. Provider file timestamps can lag; detections are not confirmed wildfire perimeters.

source.name: NASA EONET
source.methodology: Curated event metadata intersecting the monitoring rectangle; upstream references can overlap other sources.

source.name: OpenAQ Ground Monitors
source.methodology: Latest PM2.5 readings joined to station sensor metadata. Samples up to five fixed Pakistan stations, not nationwide coverage.

source.name: NASA POWER Daily Archive
source.methodology: Daily gridded solar and meteorological archive, UTC, seven-day window ending seven days before retrieval. Not a climate baseline or ground observation.

source.name: GDACS Disaster Alerts
source.methodology: GDACS reported events explicitly naming Pakistan as an affected country. Seven-day event-end search, bounded pagination; no district impact inference. No reported events does not establish safety.
source.license: GDACS attribution required; provider disclaimer applies

source.license: Official government publication; source documents retain their rights.
source.methodology: Published titles, date-only labels and document links from the first page of the official NDMA advisory index. Does not interpret PDF contents, validity periods, district applicability or absence of hazards.

source.name: CHIRPS · ClimateSERV
source.methodology: Daily CHIRPS area-mean rainfall over a 0.05° square around the selected point. Latest thirty usable calendar days within a ninety-day query ending ten days before retrieval; publication lag and missing granules remain explicit. Not a forecast or gauge reading.
source.license: UCSB CHIRPS / ClimateSERV provider terms; attribution required

source.name: PRISM scheduled evidence archive
source.methodology: Daily derived snapshot of public evidence briefings; inherits original connector families, timestamps and limitations. This archive is not an independent source. GitHub scheduling may be delayed.
source.license: Original upstream licences apply to embedded evidence

source.name: WorldPop Population Context
source.methodology: Provider-calculated 2025 population estimate in a 0.01-degree square around the selected point, using 100 m WorldPop data. Not district population, current census or flood-exposed population.

source.name: OpenStreetMap Nearby Facilities
source.methodology: Mapped school, hospital, clinic and fire-station nodes and ways in a 0.01-degree query square. Way coordinates are bounding-box centres, not entrances. Relations, mapping completeness, opening status and route safety are not assessed.

source.name: NASA GIBS Flood Imagery
source.methodology: NASA LANCE MODIS 3-day flood classification and VIIRS imagery. Metadata describes global publication periods, not clear-sky coverage at a coordinate. Clouds and insufficient data do not mean no flooding.
source.license: NASA Earthdata open imagery; acknowledge NASA GIBS/LANCE

sections.title: Executive Answer
sections.text: Sukkur: PRISM cannot determine local flood danger, route safety, school closures or evacuation needs from the available model evidence. Check the dated official advisories below and confirm instructions with local authorities. Available source-backed readings follow; missing calibration is not an API outage.
